crossRefs.note: Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant; and our couch is verdant.
Behold, it is Solomon’s carriage! Sixty mighty men are around it, of the mighty men of Israel.
Behold, I will throw her into a bed, and those who commit adultery with her into great oppression, unless they repent…
The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt. The king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a…
Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded.
Your sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt, that it might be to you for a banner. Blue and purple…

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
translations.bsb: I have decked my bed with coverings, with colored linen from Egypt.
translations.kjv: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.
translations.asv: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, With striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
